title: Formation data with two product moles
statement:
For $\ce{2A(g) + X2(g) -> 2AX(g)}$, use hypothetical formation enthalpies $\Delta H_f^\circ(\ce{A})=[$a]$ kJ/mol and $\Delta H_f^\circ(\ce{AX})=-[$p]$ kJ/mol. X₂ is in its elemental reference state. Find $\Delta H^\circ$.

[________]{a}

feedback.message: Include both coefficients of two before subtracting.

hints: Write the products and reactants sums separately.
Use zero for the stated elemental reference state.
Include both coefficients of two before subtracting.
solution: The product sum is $-2([$p])$, and the reactant sum is $2([$a])+0$. Their difference is $-2([$p])-2([$a])$ kJ.
